name: Sadaoka Matsuo
source:
The twin brother of Tomiko. A boy who dresses in lolita cosplay while performing in a band. Even though it's summer, he's always dizzy because his lolita costume is so hot.

He's actually a middle school student in Angela Academy.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080611152903/http://www.hanerom.dojin.com/natuiro_cyara_kanata.html]official website[/url]]
